verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at support.claude.com and an agent-readable markdown version of the 'Get started with Claude Design' help article, so an agent can be pointed at machine-oriented docs for this product. These are shared Claude Help Center resources rather than dedicated Claude Design agent docs, and the probe excerpt does not show that the llms.txt index lists Claude Design content. missing for 10: a product-specific llms.txt or agent-oriented docs section for Claude Design, evidence that the llms.txt index covers Claude Design articles, any OpenAPI or machine-readable spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent or hands-on confirmation of agents using these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
